candidate_chess_story_beats.editorial_hypothesis: Long castling puts Morphy's rook on d1; do not pretend rook magically appears.
Rook capture on d7, followed by black rook recapture 13...Rxd7 at ply26.
White offers the queen; black plays 16...Nxb8 in the candidate score.
Game-end mate in candidate secondary notation; unlike EP01, editorial ending can coincide with source-declared game end only after independent verification.
